narration.text: The ark scraped rock and stopped. Everyone froze. They had landed. But when they looked out, there was still nothing but water, and no ground to stand on.
And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
Two more months of waiting, and then the first grey peaks rose out of the water like islands. The world was coming back. But coming back is not the same as being ready.
